notes: from the beginning even unto the end renders two bare infinitives absolute with a waw between them: the waw takes even under rule 14, and each infinitive takes the preposition and determiner the ASV supplies to state what it contributes (rules 15, 33), headed on the word carrying the lexeme.
The demonstrative הוּא takes the phrase's one written determiner, so both articles in בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא are unrepresented (rules 41, 47).
